title: Flide: Accelerating Decision Inference with Exact State Forking
summary: Decision models such as Jev have emerged as a highly promising paradigm for LLM agent systems, providing lightweight and reliable categorical reasoning for rapid System One execution. However, existing generation-oriented inference engines fail to support these workloads effectively, suffering from severe prefix recomputation overheads or distorted output probabilities. To address this challenge, we propose Flide, an efficient and exact inference engine that decouples the logical tree structure of a decision request from its physical execution within a single flattened token stream. Through ForkAttention, Flide navigates request dependencies using GPU-resident indices across both standard attention and recurrent Gated DeltaNet layers, guaranteeing in exact arithmetic that every query branch evaluates identically to an isolated forward pass. By expressing branch topologies directly in GPU-resident metadata, Flide accommodates diverse request mixtures with a compact set of pre-recorded execution graphs while enabling expanding agent histories to resume from checkpoints saved in earlier passes. Extensive evaluations on public hybrid and decision models demonstrate that Flide answers queries up to 9.5 times faster than vLLM and SGLang while staying closest to a float32 reference in total variation distance. By unifying physical execution throughput with mathematical exactness, Flide establishes a principled foundation for scalable, latency-critical decision intelligence in agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Flide推理引擎，通过ForkAttention技术解耦决策模型的逻辑树与物理执行，实现高效且精确的LLM智能体推理。
AI.motivation: 现有的面向生成的推理引擎无法有效支持如Jev这样的LLM智能体决策模型，会导致严重的前缀重计算开销或输出概率失真。
AI.method: 提出Flide推理引擎，利用ForkAttention将逻辑树结构与单条扁平化token流中的物理执行解耦；通过GPU常驻索引在标准注意力和循环Gated DeltaNet层中导航依赖关系，确保分支评估与隔离的前向传递在算术上完全一致。
AI.result: 实验表明，Flide在回答查询时比vLLM和SGLang快最高达9.5倍，且在总变分距离上最接近float32参考基准，保证了输出的精确性。
AI.conclusion: Flide成功将物理执行吞吐量与数学精确性相统一，为智能体系统中可扩展、低延迟的决策智能奠定了原则性基础。

title: Latent Sparse Attention: Towards Subquadratic Ultra-Long Context Attention
summary: Agentic workflows are increasingly shifting towards long-horizon tasks, such as open-ended scientific work, where models benefit from long context windows. However, at ultra-long context (above 1M tokens), full attention is prohibitively expensive. A promising approach is sparse attention, in which a dedicated indexer selects a subset of keys for the attention. Yet current methods of indexing either still have quadratic cost in context size or lose accuracy at ultra-long context scale. We address this with Latent Sparse Attention (LSA), an efficient attention method that maintains accuracy at ultra-long context. In LSA, keys are hierarchically clustered in a learned latent space, and queries score the hierarchy of clusters instead of scoring every key, making prefill, decode and training faster at long context. We propose two variants, Distilled-LSA (D-LSA), which can be applied to pre-trained models via distillation, and Native-LSA (N-LSA), which is trained natively on the next-token loss alone. On GLM-5.3-FLASH (QWEN-3.8-27B) at 10M tokens, D-LSA speeds up one attention layer by 22.7x (72.4x) in prefill and 4.6x (42.5x) in decode over its original sparse attention (full attention), while keeping similar accuracy across a variety of tasks. N-LSA matches the accuracy of full attention with a training speedup of 1.6x per layer at 128k tokens. LSA offers practical and efficient attention for models to benefit from ultra-long context.

AI.tldr: 提出潜在稀疏注意力（LSA），通过在学习的潜在空间中分层聚类键，使模型在超长上下文中保持高精度的同时大幅提升预填充、解码和训练速度。
AI.motivation: 解决代理工作流在处理超长上下文（如百万级token）时，全注意力机制计算成本过高，而现有稀疏注意力方法仍存在二次方复杂度或精度下降的问题。
AI.method: 提出潜在稀疏注意力（LSA），在学习的潜在空间中对键进行分层聚类，查询通过对簇层级打分而非为每个键打分来加速计算。包含两个变体：通过蒸馏应用于预训练模型的D-LSA，以及基于下一token损失原生训练的N-LSA。
AI.result: 在1000万token的GLM-5.3-FLASH上，D-LSA在预填充阶段相比原稀疏注意力（全注意力）加速22.7倍（72.4倍），解码阶段加速4.6倍（42.5倍），且精度相当；N-LSA在12.8万token时训练每层加速1.6倍，精度匹配全注意力。
AI.conclusion: LSA为模型提供了一种实用且高效的注意力机制，使模型能够有效利用超长上下文。

title: Hierarchical World Models with Implicit Dynamics
summary: Planning with world models enables test-time adaptation for embodied agents, offering superior generalization over direct policy learning. However, long-horizon tasks remain hindered by cumulative errors and search complexity. Existing hierarchical methods often use rigid macro-actions or latent skills, leading to brittle representations and limited fine-grained control. We introduce ID-WM (Implicit Dynamics World Models), a hierarchical world model that decouples state-space reachability from local control. Our framework utilizes a high-level model to sample feasible transitions across the state manifold and a low-level world model as an inverse dynamics solver to ground these transitions into precise actions. This allows the planner to identify reachable subgoals without being constrained by low-level execution details. By prioritizing local physical feasibility over global behavioral patterns, ID-WM synthesizes novel long-horizon plans from short segments, transcending the specific behavioral modes seen during training. We demonstrate its effectiveness across three navigation and manipulation suites, achieving a 38.5% improvement over state-of-the-art policy and diffusion-based planners. Crucially, by leveraging this hierarchical structure to mitigate compounding errors, our approach yields a 135% performance gain over single-level world model MPC, particularly in complex, unseen configurations for long-horizon tasks. Videos can be viewed at https://id-wm.github.io

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分层世界模型ID-WM，通过解耦状态空间可达性与局部控制，有效解决了具身智能体长时程任务中的累积误差与搜索复杂性问题。
AI.motivation: 长时程任务受制于累积误差和搜索复杂性，而现有的分层方法使用僵化的宏观动作或潜在技能，导致表示脆弱且细粒度控制受限。
AI.method: 提出ID-WM（隐式动力学世界模型），利用高层模型在状态流形上采样可行的状态跃迁，并使用低层世界模型作为逆动力学求解器将其转化为精确动作，优先考虑局部物理可行性而非全局行为模式。
AI.result: 在三个导航与操作测试集中，相比最先进的策略和基于扩散的规划器提升了38.5%；通过缓解累积误差，相比单层世界模型MPC实现了135%的性能提升（尤其在复杂、未见过的长时程任务配置中）。
AI.conclusion: ID-WM通过分层结构成功缓解了长时程规划中的累积误差，能从短片段合成新型长时程规划，超越了训练数据中的特定行为模式，为具身智能体适应复杂未见环境提供了重要方向。

title: Dittany: Contribution-Guided Repair Framework for MAS Applications
summary: LLM-based multi-agent system (MAS) applications can produce useful intermediate results while leaving task requirements unsatisfied. Repairing such executions requires identifying the work still needed and the completed results that can support it. We present \tool, a contribution-guided runtime repair framework for MAS applications. \tool derives expected contributions and acceptance conditions from task requirements and method specifications, and connects their dependencies in a contribution graph. Runtime checks locate unmet conditions and establish which results remain usable. These results guide action-level correction when available inputs suffice, or graph-level recovery when prerequisites or unfinished work need revision. Both repair scopes retain validated contributions and check repaired outputs before subsequent work uses them. We evaluate \tool on 30 applications across six MAS frameworks and 9,000 tasks. It detects runtime failures with 88.28\% precision and 79.18\% recall, and achieves 84.76\% task accuracy, improving over Native execution by 26.74 percentage points and the strongest of four recovery baselines by 21.28 points. Estimated deployment token consumption is 17.92\% above Native, but 24.19\% below Reflexion and 13.05\% below Iterative Rollback. Ablation results show that combining the two repair scopes achieves higher accuracy and lower token consumption than graph-level repair alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种贡献引导的运行时修复框架，通过复用有效的中间结果来修复LLM多智能体系统中未满足任务要求的执行过程。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体系统（MAS）在执行任务时会产生有用的中间结果，但最终任务需求往往未得到满足。修复此类执行过程需要准确识别仍需完成的工作以及可供复用的已完成结果，而现有方法缺乏对此的有效支持。
AI.method: 提出一种贡献引导的运行时修复框架。该框架从任务需求和方法规范中推导预期贡献和验收条件，构建依赖贡献图；运行时检查定位未满足条件及可用结果，并据此指导动作级修正或图级恢复。两种修复范围均保留已验证的贡献，并在后续工作使用前检查修复后的输出。
AI.result: 在6个MAS框架、30个应用和9000个任务上评估，该框架以88.28%的精确率和79.18%的召回率检测运行时故障，任务准确率达84.76%（比原生执行高26.74个百分点，比最强基线高21.28个百分点）。其Token消耗仅比原生执行高17.92%，且显著低于Reflexion和Iterative Rollback等基线。消融实验表明结合两种修复范围优于单一图级修复。
AI.conclusion: 结合动作级和图级修复的该框架能有效修复MAS执行故障，在显著提升任务准确率的同时控制了Token消耗开销，优于单一修复范围及现有基线方法。

title: RoboArchitect: Automating the Design of Robotic Agents with Persistent Memory
summary: Recent work shows that a frozen robot policy performs far better inside an agent harness, where control code decides when to query the policy, consult vision tools, or command the arm directly. Yet today these harnesses are built by hand and redesigned for each new robot or benchmark. We show that harness design can be automated, offering a strong alternative to finetuning on a novel setup. In RoboArchitect, a coding model observes a robot's rollouts, diagnoses failures, and iteratively revises the harness around the frozen policy. The harness evolves on a set of episodes for its optimization and is evaluated on held-out scenes and tasks. Without updating any model weights, RoboArchitect raises average success from 9.7% to 43.3% on unseen scenes (4.5x) and from 12.7% to 40.2% on unseen tasks (3.2x), across multiple benchmarks and policies. The gains are largest where the benchmark is far from the policy's training data: wrapping a general-purpose policy, the evolved harness yields a specialist that often outperforms even the finetuned version. Intuitive control strategies are automatically designed, such as lifting a jammed arm clear or reaching in horizontally when an obstacle blocks the way from above. The harness also evolves its own persistent memory, carrying learned experience, such as effective grasp depths, into later decisions. These results suggest that substantial headroom in robotic manipulation lies in the agent harness, and its design can be effectively automated and optimized without weight updates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RoboArchitect，通过自动化设计围绕冻结机器人策略的智能体外壳，在无需更新权重的情况下显著提升了操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器人策略智能体外壳需手动构建且针对新环境重新设计。本文旨在解决外壳设计高度依赖人工的问题，探索自动化设计作为新设置下微调的替代方案。
AI.method: RoboArchitect利用编程模型观察机器人的试错过程，诊断失败原因，并围绕冻结的策略迭代修改外壳代码。该外壳还能演化出持久记忆，将学到的经验应用于后续决策。
AI.result: 在不更新模型权重的情况下，系统在未见场景上的成功率提升4.5倍（9.7%至43.3%），在未见任务上提升3.2倍（12.7%至40.2%）。对于偏离策略训练数据的基准，演化出的外壳性能甚至超过微调版本，并能自动生成直观的控制策略。
AI.conclusion: 机器人操作领域的巨大潜力存在于智能体外壳设计中，该过程可被有效自动化并在不更新权重的前提下实现性能的大幅优化。

title: Subquadratic Attention with a Hierarchical Tree-Structured Indexer
summary: The quadratic scaling of attention is a fundamental bottleneck limiting the long-context capabilities of large language models (LLMs). A variety of approaches have attempted to circumvent this, but they either fail to match attention's expressiveness (e.g., sliding-window or linear attention variants with fixed-size state) or only achieve constant-factor speedups (e.g., sparse attention methods whose indexers themselves scale quadratically). In this paper, we derive an asymptotically subquadratic sparse attention method based on a hierarchical, tree-structured indexer, which we call Zyphra Hierarchical Attention (ZHA). ZHA constructs a tree of recursively compressed key summaries over the KV cache, which future queries traverse from the top down to retrieve a sparse subset of keys. Crucially, by iteratively growing the tree's depth, the total cost including routing and final attention grows sublinearly in sequence length, resulting in overall subquadratic (but superlinear) scaling for attention. We demonstrate that ZHA can be cheaply applied to existing pretrained models with only a short KL distillation training stage over a few billion tokens, and maintains performance on long-context retrieval and challenging reasoning, mathematical, and agentic coding evaluation tasks. Moreover, we show that our method is highly robust to tree geometry including very deep trees of up to 6 levels. Finally, we develop a detailed performance model and show that our approach scales subquadratically, dramatically outperforms competing methods beyond 1 million context, and ultimately has the potential to extend effective context windows to the hundreds of millions or billions of tokens.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Zyphra Hierarchical Attention (ZHA)的次二次稀疏注意力方法，通过树状分层索引器实现高效的超长上下文处理。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型中注意力的二次方复杂度是限制长上下文能力的核心瓶颈，而现有方法要么缺乏表达能力，要么仅能提供常数级加速。
AI.method: 提出ZHA方法，构建一棵由递归压缩的键摘要组成的树，查询自顶向下遍历该树以检索稀疏键子集。通过迭代增加树的深度，使总计算成本随序列长度次线性增长，实现次二次缩放。该方法可通过简短的KL蒸馏应用于现有的预训练模型。
AI.result: ZHA在仅需短时间KL蒸馏的情况下，于长上下文检索、推理、数学及智能体编程任务上保持良好性能。该方法对树结构（深达6层）具有鲁棒性，且在超过100万上下文时显著优于竞争方法，具有扩展至数亿或数十亿token的潜力。
AI.conclusion: ZHA成功解决了注意力机制的二次方扩展瓶颈，不仅能够高效适配现有预训练模型并保持多任务性能，还为未来实现数亿至数十亿级token的有效上下文窗口奠定了基础。

title: Quantum 3xplorer: AI-Native Engine for Next-Generation Quantum Materials Modeling
summary: Quantum-mechanical approaches, such as density functional theory (DFT), underpin much of modern computational materials science and are the primary source of data for AI-driven discovery. Yet the established electronic-structure codes today represent decades-old software architectures, making new physical models slow and costly to implement, validate, and deploy on emerging hardware. We present Quantum 3xplorer (Q3, pronounced "Quantum Explorer"), an AI-native quantum simulation engine written from scratch by AI coding agents under the direction and supervision of domain scientists. As a first and demanding validation case, we implement plane-wave pseudopotential DFT end to end: norm-conserving, ultrasoft, and projector-augmented-wave formalisms, spin polarization, DFT+U, and dispersion corrections, together with forces, stresses, structural relaxation, and electronic-structure analysis. Q3 reproduces established reference implementations, runs faster on a single core in representative benchmarks, and scales across GPU-accelerated supercomputers. It was developed in weeks rather than years. Its layered, physics-first architecture separates abstract quantum-mechanical concepts from their numerical representations, making its framework extendable beyond plane waves to other basis sets and levels of theory. Its inputs and outputs follow structured, schema-validated data standards, making every result AI-ready. Q3 is open source under Apache 2.0 and built to be reused, extended, and improved by the research community. Q3 points to a paradigm shift in how computational quantum science is done. Scientists define the physics, formulate the models, and set the criteria for validation; AI agents write, test, and optimize the code. The decades-long path from a new theory to a trusted, high-performance implementation can thus collapse to days, significantly accelerating scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Quantum 3xplorer（Q3），一个由AI编程代理在领域科学家指导下从头编写的AI原生量子模拟引擎，实现了平面波赝势DFT的端到端计算，并在数周内完成开发。
AI.motivation: 现有电子结构代码基于数十年前的软件架构，导致新物理模型的实现、验证和在新兴硬件上的部署缓慢且成本高昂，阻碍了AI驱动的材料发现的效率。
AI.method: Q3采用分层、物理优先的架构，将抽象量子力学概念与数值表示分离；由科学家定义物理和验证标准，AI代理编写、测试和优化代码；输入输出遵循结构化、模式验证的数据标准，使所有结果具备AI就绪性。
AI.result: Q3完整实现了范数守恒、超软和投影增强波形式的平面波赝势DFT，包括自旋极化、DFT+U和色散校正，以及力、应力、结构弛豫和电子结构分析；在代表性基准测试中单核运行速度更快，可跨GPU加速超级计算机扩展，并在数周而非数年内完成开发。
AI.conclusion: Q3标志着计算量子科学的范式转变，科学家定义物理、模型和验证标准，AI代理编写和优化代码，使从新理论到可信高性能实现的路径从数十年缩短至数天，显著加速科学发现。

title: Strategic Tanking in Stable Matching Markets
summary: Motivated by a broad literature in psychology, organizational behavior, and matching markets, we introduce strategic tanking: an agent deliberately makes themselves less attractive to selected potential partners in order to improve their eventual assignment. Unlike traditional manipulation in stable matching, a tanker does not misreport whom they prefer; instead, they influence how others rank them. We show that tanking has a striking connection to classical preference manipulation. Cutoff tanking, in which an agent tanks with every potential partner below a chosen threshold, has exactly the same effect on the stable set as truncating one's own preference list at that threshold. Thus an agent can reproduce the power of a classical truncation while leaving their own preferences unchanged and every match acceptable. Arbitrary tanking, however, can go substantially further: under proposer-deferred acceptance, tanking equilibria can lie outside the sincere stable set. More broadly, whenever the sincere stable set contains multiple matchings, profitable strategic behavior remains available through either traditional preference manipulation or tanking, even when one side is restricted to honestly reporting their own preferences.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为“战略性摆烂”的匹配市场操纵策略，即代理人通过故意降低自身吸引力来改善最终匹配结果。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在探索稳定匹配市场中一种新型的操纵策略，与传统的偏好误报不同，代理人通过影响他人对自己的排名来获取更优匹配，从而解决并揭示了匹配市场中的深层操纵机制。
AI.method: 引入“战略性摆烂”概念，证明了“截止摆烂”与传统的偏好列表截断在稳定集上具有等价效应；进一步在提议者延迟接受机制下，分析了任意摆烂对均衡结果的深远影响。
AI.result: 截止摆烂能在保持自身偏好不变且所有匹配均可接受的情况下，重现传统截断的效力；任意摆烂能使均衡超出真诚稳定集；此外，只要真诚稳定集包含多个匹配，即使一方诚实报告偏好，传统操纵或摆烂仍能带来收益。
AI.conclusion: 战略性摆烂在稳定匹配中与传统偏好操纵具有深刻联系，且能在特定条件下突破真诚稳定集，这表明即使对偏好报告施加诚实限制，匹配市场中仍不可避免地存在有利可图的策略操纵行为。

title: Towards Understanding the Impact of Plasticity Loss on Reinforcement Learning in Stochastic Environments
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) is a powerful framework for sequential decision-making. Despite many high-profile successes in recent years, deep RL is known to be brittle. An emerging line of research attributes this brittleness to a loss of plasticity in neural networks. However, plasticity loss has so far been understudied in stochastic environments. We study this interplay systematically, training SAC agents on three DeepMind Control tasks augmented with controlled levels of observation and action noise. We find that plasticity-preserving methods increase learning robustness on the two harder tasks, with their advantage growing as observation noise increases, while combining resets with layer normalization underperforms resets alone at every observation noise level tested. Further, stochasticity can accelerate the loss of plasticity in harder environments, whereas in easier settings noise can act as a regularizer that sustains plasticity. Lastly, plasticity loss is most pronounced in the early stages of training. In the most challenging stochastic settings, TD instability rather than gradual plasticity loss becomes the dominant failure mode.
comment: 9 pages main paper, 15 pages references and appendix, 17 figures. Presented at the Nineteenth European Workshop on Reinforcement Learning (EWRL 2026)

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了深度强化学习中随机环境对神经网络可塑性丧失的影响，发现噪声在不同难度任务中起双刃剑作用，且极端随机环境下主要失败模式转化为TD不稳定性。
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习虽成果显著但具有脆弱性，新兴研究将此归因于神经网络可塑性丧失。然而，目前对可塑性丧失在随机环境（观测与动作噪声）中的表现研究不足。
AI.method: 在三个DeepMind Control任务上训练SAC智能体，通过引入受控水平的观测和动作噪声，系统研究随机环境与可塑性丧失及保持方法之间的相互作用。
AI.result: 保持可塑性的方法在困难任务上提升了学习鲁棒性且优势随观测噪声增加而扩大；重置结合层归一化在所有观测噪声水平下均劣于单独重置。随机性在困难环境中加速可塑性丧失，在简单环境中则作为正则化器维持可塑性。可塑性丧失在训练早期最明显，而在最具挑战性的随机设置中，TD不稳定性成为主要失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 噪声对可塑性的影响取决于任务难度。未来抗脆弱性深度强化学习算法的设计应重点关注训练早期的可塑性丧失以及高噪声环境下的TD不稳定性。

title: Think in 360°: Benchmarking and Bootstrapping Panoramic Video Reasoning
summary: A panoramic video captures all directions around the camera, but relevant evidence can appear in different directions and at different times. Understanding it requires models to connect observations across the viewing sphere and time. We introduce PanoVideoBench, the first manually annotated benchmark for comprehensive panoramic video understanding. Its 1,000 questions span five categories and 15 question types, with diagnostic annotations for target search and panoramic capabilities. Evaluation of 11 proprietary, open-source, and panoramic-specialized models identifies cross-view tracking and sphere-time evidence integration as their weakest capabilities. To strengthen these capabilities, we construct PanoVideoCoT, the first reasoning dataset grounded in real panoramic video, through sphere-time-grounded synthesis that converts verified panoramic observations and successful agentic explorations into 13,465 QA-CoT pairs. Starting from a general video MLLM, PanoVideoReasoner learns from this corpus through Panoramic CoT SFT and Evidence-Privileged On-Policy Self-Distillation, a panoramic instantiation of Vision-OPD's OPSD in which the teacher uses verified perspective views to guide student-generated trajectories. It reaches 55.7% on PanoVideoBench, improving the backbone by 12.5 points and the previous SOTA by 2.6. The gains concentrate on the same spatial, cross-view, and temporal capabilities exposed by the benchmark, showing that grounded sphere-time supervision can equip a general video MLLM with panoramic reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了全景视频理解基准PanoVideoBench和推理数据集PanoVideoCoT，并通过CoT微调与自蒸馏训练PanoVideoReasoner模型，显著提升了模型的全景视频推理能力。
AI.motivation: 全景视频中的关键证据可能出现在不同方向和不同时间，而现有模型在跨视图跟踪和球面-时间证据整合方面存在明显的能力缺陷。
AI.method: 构建了手动标注的基准PanoVideoBench及基于真实全景视频的推理数据集PanoVideoCoT，通过全景思维链监督微调（SFT）和证据特权在线策略自蒸馏训练PanoVideoReasoner模型。
AI.result: PanoVideoReasoner在PanoVideoBench上达到55.7%的准确率，较基础骨干模型提升12.5个百分点，较先前的SOTA提升2.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 基于球面-时间的监督能够有效赋予通用视频多模态大语言模型全景推理能力，尤其在空间、跨视图和时间维度上表现突出。

title: KV Cache Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
summary: KV cache quantization is well studied for autoregressive language models, where cached prefix states are exact under causal attention and quantization is mainly a cache reconstruction problem. Diffusion language models (dLLMs) break this assumption. Fast dLLM inference reuses KV states across denoising steps, but bidirectional token representations can change as masked tokens are revealed, so the reused cache may already differ from full recomputation before quantization is applied. We study KV cache quantization under this cache-reuse error. We adapt KIVI and KVQuant to Fast-dLLM-style prefix and dual cache reuse, and introduce TRACE and dLLM-KVQ. TRACE reconstructs feasible dLLM reveal trajectories from prompt-answer pairs, providing calibration states that match iterative masked decoding. dLLM-KVQ uses these trajectories to choose per-layer K-cache entries that remain in high precision according to output- and attention-level behavior metrics, while applying standard low-bit value quantization. Across LLaDA and Dream evaluations on GSM8K, HumanEval, MATH, and MBPP, dLLM-KVQ achieves the highest average score among quantized methods across the reported 4-bit and 2-bit prefix/dual cache settings.

AI.tldr: 本文针对扩散语言模型中KV缓存重用误差问题，提出了TRACE轨迹重建方法和dLLM-KVQ混合精度量化方法。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型在跨去噪步骤重用KV状态时，由于双向注意力下掩码token的揭示会导致表示变化，使得重用的缓存在量化前就已存在误差。本文旨在研究并解决该特定缓存重用误差下的KV缓存量化问题。
AI.method: 本文将KIVI和KVQuant适配到快速dLLM的前缀和双缓存重用中，并提出了TRACE和dLLM-KVQ。TRACE通过提示-答案对重建可行的dLLM揭示轨迹，提供匹配迭代掩码解码的校准状态；dLLM-KVQ则利用这些轨迹，根据输出和注意力层面的行为指标，选择保持高精度的逐层K缓存条目，同时对其他部分应用标准的低比特值量化。
AI.result: 在LLaDA和Dream模型上针对GSM8K、HumanEval、MATH和MBPP数据集的评估显示，dLLM-KVQ在所报告的4位和2位前缀/双缓存设置中，实现了量化方法中的最高平均分。
AI.conclusion: dLLM-KVQ有效解决了扩散语言模型推理中因缓存重用和量化带来的误差问题，显著提升了低比特量化下的模型性能，为高效dLLM推理提供了有效方案。

title: DWISE: Denoising Workload-Informed Scheduling Engine
summary: Unlike autoregressive large language models (AR-LLMs), diffusion LLMs (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising many tokens in parallel, offering a promising path to efficient inference. Existing serving frameworks, however, schedule dLLM requests with policies designed for AR models, namely first-come-first-served (FCFS) admission and prefill priority. We find that both policies are ill-suited to dLLMs, wasting much of their speed. FCFS ignores that a dLLM request's decoding cost is highly heterogeneous and unknown at arrival, causing severe head-of-line blocking. Prefill priority, widely used in AR-LLM serving to keep time-to-first-token low, sharply cuts dLLM efficiency, as rounds that run only prompts leave most of the batch idle. We present DWISE, a Denoising Workload-Informed Scheduling Engine for efficient dLLM serving. DWISE schedules requests by their remaining work, measured in a block-level unit shared by prefill and denoising, so both phases share a round. To predict the unknown denoising workload, DWISE combines a lightweight prompt-based predictor at admission with a single refinement from the first denoising round's hidden states, which capture model-specific information absent from the prompt and require no additional model execution. Implemented in SGLang and evaluated on five models from three dLLM families under bursty workloads, DWISE reduces mean end-to-end latency over SGLang by 5.4$\times$ on average and up to 14.9$\times$ while preserving task accuracy. The code will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DWISE，一个用于高效服务扩散语言模型的工作量感知调度引擎，通过预测去噪工作量并优化调度策略显著降低了端到端延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有服务框架采用为自回归模型设计的调度策略（如FCFS和预填充优先），导致dLLM解码成本异构性引发队头阻塞，且纯预填充轮次使批量利用率低下，严重浪费了dLLM的并行解码速度。
AI.method: DWISE以块级单位衡量请求的剩余工作量进行调度，使预填充与去噪阶段共享计算轮次；结合轻量级提示预测器与首轮去噪隐藏状态的细化，无需额外模型执行即可预测未知去噪工作量。
AI.result: 在SGLang上实现并在三种dLLM家族的五个模型及突发工作负载下评估，DWISE平均降低端到端延迟5.4倍（最高14.9倍），且未损失任务精度。
AI.conclusion: DWISE克服了传统AR模型调度策略在dLLM上的不适配问题，通过工作量感知机制大幅提升了扩散语言模型的服务效率和推理速度。

title: Cord: Confidence-Anchored Order Residual Decoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: The decoding order of masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) can substantially affect generation quality, yet common decoders typically apply the same reveal rule throughout generation. Confidence provides a strong default, but it measures how decisively a position can be predicted now, not how useful revealing that position will be for subsequent decoding. We propose Cord, a lightweight prompt-conditioned policy that retains confidence decoding as a stable reference and learns when and how to depart from it through geometric residuals over generation direction, proximity to revealed context, and two-sided infilling. The residuals adapt to both the prompt and the evolving partial response. Rather than sampling a new policy action at every decoding step, Cord samples a single low-dimensional coefficient matrix per rollout, which induces an entire state-dependent reveal trajectory. This yields a contextual-bandit formulation trained directly from sequence-level rewards, without step-level credit assignment or backbone updates. Across three dLLMs and five reasoning, code, and constraint-satisfaction benchmarks, Cord improves average task success from 32.0% under confidence decoding to 48.2%, and further improves over the best per-domain fixed residual. Behavioral audits show that the learned residuals induce substantial, task-dependent changes in reveal locality and two-sided infilling. Cord adds only $0.53$M trainable parameters, requires no additional backbone forward passes, and incurs only 5.39% inference latency overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出一种名为Cord的轻量级提示条件解码策略，通过几何残差动态调整掩码扩散语言模型的解码顺序，从而提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型的解码顺序显著影响生成质量，但传统的置信度解码仅衡量当前位置当前的可预测性，未考虑揭示该位置对后续解码的有用性，且缺乏动态适应性。
AI.method: Cord保留置信度解码作为参考，通过生成方向、邻近上下文和双向填充的几何残差学习何时及如何偏离它。该方法每次rollout仅采样一个低维系数矩阵以生成状态依赖的揭示轨迹，并利用上下文赌博机直接从序列级奖励进行训练，无需步级信用分配或骨干网络更新。
AI.result: 在三个dLLMs和五个基准测试中，Cord将平均任务成功率从置信度解码的32.0%提升至48.2%，优于最佳固定残差策略。该方法仅增加0.53M参数，推理延迟开销仅5.39%。
AI.conclusion: Cord以极低的参数和延迟开销显著提升了dLLMs在多项任务上的生成质量，且学习到的残差能根据任务自适应地改变解码行为。

title: Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Uni: Elastic Self-Refining Unified Diffusion LLM with Cross-Paradigm On-Policy Distillation
summary: We propose Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Uni (NLD-Uni), a unified discrete diffusion large language model (DLLM) for visual understanding and generation tasks. Compared with prior unified diffusion models, NLD-Uni introduces two major innovations. First, we propose a unified cross-paradigm on-policy distillation (OPD) framework that successfully transfers the visual understanding ability of autoregressive VLMs and visual generation ability of continuous flow models, to a unified DLLM. Second, NLD-Uni incorporates a novel progressive self-refining diffusion process that gradually corrupts each token across multiple steps during training, as opposed to adopting the conventional masked diffusion formulation that directly corrupts a clean image token to an uninformative mask token. At inference, this design allows NLD-Uni to make intermediate commit to a token, enabling progressive self-refinement for better visual quality. Through extensive experiments, we show that NLD-Uni achieves state-of-the-art performance among unified DLLMs on diverse tasks including visual question-answering, multi-modal reasoning, object grounding, text-to-image generation, and image editing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了NLD-Uni，一个用于视觉理解和生成任务的统一离散扩散大语言模型。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在解决以往统一扩散模型在结合自回归视觉语言模型和连续流模型能力时的局限性，并克服传统掩码扩散直接将干净令牌破坏为无信息掩码的缺陷。
AI.method: 提出统一的跨范式策略蒸馏（OPD）框架以转移理解与生成能力，并引入渐进式自优化扩散过程，在训练时逐步破坏令牌，在推理时允许对令牌进行中间提交以实现渐进式优化。
AI.result: NLD-Uni在视觉问答、多模态推理、目标定位、文本到图像生成和图像编辑等多项任务的统一DLLM中取得了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: NLD-Uni通过创新的蒸馏框架和渐进式自优化扩散过程，成功实现了视觉理解与生成任务的统一，并在多种应用中展现出卓越性能。

title: Learning When to Commit: Schedule Distillation for Fast Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) can generate multiple tokens in parallel, but often require many decoding rounds to complete a response. Efficient generation depends not only on which tokens are easy to predict, but also on how committing to them helps predict the remaining positions. A highly predictable token may provide little useful context, while revealing a less predictable token can help several other positions become predictable sooner. We propose dSpark, a new schedule distillation-based framework for learning when to commit tokens for faster diffusion language generation. To achieve this, we construct unmasking schedules that prioritize tokens whose reveal makes other positions easier to predict, reducing uncertainty earlier in decoding. We then distill these schedules into the model to enable faster parallel sampling, with a KL-divergence regularizer to help preserve generation quality. We extensively evaluate our approach across mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks. On GSM8K, our method achieves remarkable 10.12$\times$ and 5.12$\times$ speedups over the various baselines on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-7B-Instruct, respectively, while maintaining superior task performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/VILA-Lab/dSpark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出dSpark框架，通过调度蒸馏学习何时提交标记，从而加速扩散大语言模型的并行生成。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型虽能并行生成标记，但需多次解码轮次。高效生成不仅在于预测容易的标记，更在于如何通过提交这些标记帮助预测剩余位置。
AI.method: 提出dSpark，一种基于调度蒸馏的框架。该方法构建解掩码调度，优先揭示那些能使其他位置更易预测的标记以尽早降低不确定性，随后利用KL散度正则化器将这些调度蒸馏到模型中，以实现更快的并行采样。
AI.result: 在数学推理和代码生成任务上的广泛评估表明，在GSM8K上，该方法分别在LLaDA-8B-Instruct和Dream-7B-Instruct上实现了10.12倍和5.12倍的加速，同时保持了优越的任务性能。
AI.conclusion: dSpark在不损失生成质量的前提下显著加速了扩散语言生成，代码已开源。

title: Speculative Diffusion is a Tale of Two Tradeoffs
summary: Speculative decoding is a technique that accelerates the inference speed of autoregressive large language models (LLMs) by sampling from a faster, lower quality draft model. Traditionally, a fundamental characteristic of speculative decoding is that it is lossless with respect to the verifier distribution, guaranteeing speed without sacrificing quality. This differs from recently developed diffusion LLMs (dLLMs), which are notably able to achieve substantial speedups by degrading the quality of their outputs with less diffusion effort. Because diffusion models are able to sample faster than autoregressive models by generating tokens in parallel, they are considered strong candidates for draft models in speculative diffusion. While it is widely understood that diffusion models can sacrifice quality for speed, speculative decoding itself can also be generalized to generate lossy samples faster using more lenient acceptance criteria with respect to the verifier distribution. Presented with the two parameters of diffusion effort and speculative decoding leniency, this paper explores the full achievable Pareto frontier via joint variations of these parameters. Our experiments show that jointly varying diffusion effort and acceptance leniency can extend the speed-quality Pareto frontier over single step diffusion drafting.

AI.tldr: 本文通过联合调整扩散努力程度和推测解码的验收宽容度，探索并扩展了速度与质量的帕累托前沿。
AI.motivation: 传统推测解码是无损的，而扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）通过牺牲质量换取速度。本文旨在解决如何将扩散模型作为草稿模型，并通过同时调节扩散努力程度和推测解码的宽容度来优化速度与质量的权衡。
AI.method: 提出一种联合调整两个参数的方法：扩散模型生成的努力程度和推测解码验收标准的宽容度，从而探索完整的目标帕累托前沿。
AI.result: 实验表明，联合改变扩散努力程度和验收宽容度，相比单步扩散草稿生成，能够显著扩展并提升速度与质量的帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，结合扩散模型的并行生成能力和推测解码的宽容验收机制，可以更有效地探索速度与质量的权衡空间，实现更优的加速效果。

title: Diffusion Language Models for Perplexity-Aware Black-Box Attacks
summary: \emph{Continuous-space} attacks find prompts that trigger malicious behaviors, such as overthinking, in black-box LLMs by sampling or optimizing over a low-dimensional Gaussian latent space and decoding it to text through a \emph{random mapping} and nearest-token lookup. Because the random mapping is not learned from language, its prompts can be highly unnatural, and as such easily detectable through input guardrails, and the risk estimates they yield are not grounded in natural prompts. In this paper, we demonstrate that the same continuous latent-space framework can be coupled directly to a learned generative distribution over language, a continuous diffusion language model (dLLM), which removes the artificial random mapping while preserving the standard-Gaussian latent formulation and the downstream sampling or optimization procedure. We evaluate this approach under two settings: sampling-based estimation using \emph{RareTrap} and optimization-based search using \emph{ThinkTrap}. We find that character-level perplexity drops from $10^3$--$10^7$ to 3--5 in RareTrap and from 20--28 to 4.3--5.4 in ThinkTrap. We also find that model risk estimates can differ by an order of magnitude across the two mappings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将连续潜在空间攻击框架直接耦合到连续扩散语言模型，以消除人工随机映射并生成更自然的提示来评估黑盒LLM的风险。
AI.motivation: 传统的连续空间攻击使用非学习的随机映射生成提示，导致提示极不自然、易被防御机制检测，且风险估计脱离实际自然提示场景。
AI.method: 提出将连续潜在空间框架直接与学习的语言生成分布（连续扩散语言模型，dLLM）耦合，从而在保留标准高斯潜在公式和下游采样/优化过程的同时消除人工随机映射。
AI.result: 在RareTrap和ThinkTrap两种设置下，生成提示的字符级困惑度分别从10^3--10^7和20--28大幅降至3--5和4.3--5.4；此外，不同映射下的模型风险估计可能相差一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 利用连续扩散语言模型替代随机映射能显著提高生成提示的自然度，这表明更自然的攻击方法能提供更真实的风险评估。

title: Harmful Responses Are Jailbreak Templates: Transferring Autoregressive Jailbreaks to Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) enable flexible masked generation through bidirectional context modeling, but this capability also introduces a distinct jailbreak attack surface. We find that a harmful response to a given query naturally serves as an effective jailbreak template: simply masking a subset of its tokens can induce a dLLM to reconstruct harmful content. Based on this observation, we propose RMT-Jailbreak, a general framework that transfers existing autoregressive (AR) jailbreak attacks to dLLMs through their induced harmful responses. RMT-Jailbreak converts an AR-generated harmful response into a high-mask-ratio template using uniform token retention, and further applies prompt-based safety filtering to mask any remaining visible harmful content. The refined template is then provided to the target dLLM for bidirectional reconstruction. Extensive experiments across multiple AR jailbreak methods and target dLLMs demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of RMT-Jailbreak, revealing strong cross-paradigm transferability of jailbreak attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RMT-Jailbreak框架，通过将自回归模型生成的有害响应转换为高掩码比例模板，成功将越狱攻击迁移至扩散大语言模型。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型通过双向上下文建模实现灵活的掩码生成，但这引入了独特的越狱攻击面。本文旨在利用这一漏洞，将现有的自回归（AR）越狱攻击迁移到dLLMs中。
AI.method: RMT-Jailbreak利用AR模型生成的有害响应，通过均匀保留token将其转换为高掩码比例模板，并应用基于提示的安全过滤来掩码剩余的可见有害内容，最后将该模板提供给目标dLLM进行双向重构。
AI.result: 在多种AR越狱方法和目标dLLMs上的广泛实验证明了RMT-Jailbreak的有效性和通用性，揭示了越狱攻击的强跨范式迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 越狱攻击具有从AR模型到dLLMs的强跨范式迁移性，凸显了dLLMs在掩码生成能力上的独特漏洞。

title: Trion-1: Unifying Language, Protein Sequence, and Structure with Diffusion Language Models
summary: We envision a general-purpose protein foundation model as a unified, interactive model of sequence, structure, and function, capable of understanding, generation, and cross-modal translation while retaining the instruction-following and reasoning capabilities of modern LLMs. Toward this vision, we introduce Trion-1, the first native, unified, multimodal diffusion language model (dLLM) for proteins. Trion-1 is built on two key design choices: (1) a unified discrete token space that jointly represents sequence, structure, and natural language; (2) a dLLM backbone that replaces strict left-to-right factorization with bidirectional or semi-bidirectional token interactions, enabling global residue communication and long-range contact modeling that are naturally suited to structure modeling. This formulation unifies six core capabilities: folding, inverse folding, sequence understanding, structure understanding, sequence design, and structure design, while retaining the native language capabilities of general-purpose LLMs. On established benchmarks, Trion-1 achieves broadly competitive performance. In folding, Trion-1 achieves a TM-score above 0.8 with a single sample under strict homology control, matching or exceeding the existing tri-modal model using 200 samples. For sequence understanding, Trion-1 performs on par with top-tier LLMs such as Claude Opus 4.7 (62.37%). These results support well-aligned sequence-structure-language representations and strong cross-modal generative capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Trion-1，首个原生统一的多模态扩散语言模型，用于蛋白质的序列、结构和功能的联合建模与生成。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决构建通用蛋白质基础模型的问题，使其能够统一处理序列、结构和功能，具备理解、生成和跨模态翻译能力，同时保留现代大型语言模型的指令遵循和推理能力。
AI.method: Trion-1基于两个核心设计：一是联合表示序列、结构和自然语言的统一离散标记空间；二是采用扩散语言模型骨干网络，通过双向或半双向标记交互实现全局残基通信和长程接触建模。
AI.result: 模型在多项基准测试中表现优异：在严格同源控制下单次采样折叠TM-score超过0.8，超越使用200次采样的现有三模态模型；序列理解能力与Claude Opus 4.7等顶级LLM相当（62.37%）。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，Trion-1实现了良好对齐的序列-结构-语言表示和强大的跨模态生成能力，成功迈向通用的蛋白质基础模型。

title: GRAFT: Restoring the Missing Sampling Interface in Continuous Diffusion Language Models
summary: Continuous diffusion language models generate a whole sequence in parallel, never drawing a single word at any intermediate step; only the final step turns embeddings into text. Models such as ELF now report autoregressive-level quality at a fraction of the sampling steps of discrete-token diffusion models, and this design principle -- no step-wise discretization -- is what their own ablations credit for the gain. We show that this same principle carries a hidden cost: a collapse of the lexical long tail. Measured against held-out human text, ELF's output matches the human rate on common words almost exactly, yet its rarest words appear at only 0.30x the human rate, a gap that does not close from 105M to 652M parameters and that no sampler setting these models expose can reach. A same-size GPT-2, in contrast, spans zero to above the human rate by its decoding rule alone. We trace the difference to what continuous diffusion models lack: with no step that ever draws a discrete word, every step is instead driven by an average over the candidates still in play, and averaging a rare candidate together with the common word competing for its slot lands on the common word. An autoregressive model avoids this because its decoding rule samples one candidate rather than averaging over all of them. We propose GRAFT, a training-free method that grafts this missing choice back onto a frozen model: while the model is still undecided, GRAFT commits the rare words the average would otherwise discard, then regenerates the sequence from scratch with those commitments held in place. Across three ELF scales and on LangFlow, an independent continuous dLLM, GRAFT restores the rare-word share of generated text from 0.42-0.77x the human rate to 0.82-1.10x, a relative gain of 34-109%, and moves the entire word-frequency profile closer to human on every model tested, by 2.7x on ELF-B and 12x on LangFlow.

AI.tldr: 连续扩散语言模型由于缺乏逐步离散化导致罕见词汇生成率极低，本文提出无需训练的GRAFT方法将离散选择机制重新引入模型，成功恢复了罕见词汇的生成率。
AI.motivation: 连续扩散语言模型（如ELF）在每一步对候选词求平均而非抽取离散词汇，导致罕见词汇（词汇长尾）的生成率远低于人类水平，且无法通过增加参数规模或调整采样器设置来缓解。
AI.method: 提出GRAFT，一种无需训练的方法。在模型尚未决定时，GRAFT强制提交那些原本会被平均值丢弃的罕见词汇，并在这些承诺保持不变的情况下从头重新生成序列。
AI.result: 在三种规模的ELF模型和独立的LangFlow模型上，GRAFT将生成文本中的罕见词汇占比从人类频率的0.42-0.77倍恢复至0.82-1.10倍（相对提升34-109%），并使整个词频分布更接近人类水平。
AI.conclusion: 通过GRAFT方法将自回归模型中的离散选择机制移植回连续扩散语言模型，能够有效解决词汇长尾崩溃问题，显著提升生成文本的词汇多样性与人类相似度。

title: Where Draft Trees Lose Target Mass: Exit-Guided Speculative Decoding
summary: Tree-based speculative decoding verifies multiple draft continuations in one target-model pass, but finite trees built from draft scores face a fundamental draft-target mismatch. We ask whether better exact verification can increase acceptance on a fixed tree and how target feedback can improve the tree itself. Through a target-flow view, we identify a canonical exit law and prove that one plus target coverage sharply bounds the expected output-block length, including the bonus token, of any exact path verifier. All optimal verifiers share the same exit and bonus-token law, already attained by representative predraw-and-follow and sequential residual verifiers. This yields Tree Exit Verification (TEV), an exact, level-parallel procedure using one exit-node decision and one bonus-token decision. The exit law also identifies missing target probability, providing node-level feedback for Exit-Guided Draft-Tree Training (ExitTrain) on inference-time draft trees. Experiments across dialogue, code, and mathematical reasoning validate fixed-tree equivalence: ExitTrain increases average output-block length by 13%, while TEV reduces verifier-stage latency by 15%, yielding a 14% end-to-end speedup over DDTree. Our results distinguish two opportunities: better draft trees for higher acceptance and more direct verification for lower latency. Code: https://github.com/hsj576/TEV.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了树退出验证（TEV）和退出引导草稿树训练（ExitTrain），通过优化精确验证和目标反馈机制，显著降低了延迟并提高了推测解码的接受率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于树的推测解码存在草稿与目标模型不匹配的问题，限制了固定树上草稿的接受率并增加了验证延迟。
AI.method: 提出目标流视角并证明退出法则界限；基于此提出TEV（层级并行的精确验证过程）和ExitTrain（利用缺失目标概率作为节点级反馈来训练草稿树）。
AI.result: 实验表明，ExitTrain使平均输出块长度增加13%，TEV使验证阶段延迟降低15%，相比DDTree实现了14%的端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: 提高推测解码效率有两个关键机会：构建更好的草稿树以提高接受率，以及采用更直接的验证方法以降低延迟。

title: DominoTree: Conditional Tree-Structured Drafting with Domino for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding speeds up large language model inference: a small drafter proposes several tokens, and the target model verifies them in one parallel pass. Drafting a tree lets the target verify many alternative continuations at once. DDTree builds such trees from the block-diffusion drafter DFlash, but scores each position independently of the tokens earlier in its branch; Domino conditions on those tokens but drafts only a single chain. DominoTree combines the two: a training-free best-first tree scored by Domino's path-dependent causal correction, restricted to top-M candidates. In a research harness at temperature zero, it averages 5.33x speedup over autoregressive (AR) decoding on Qwen3-4B and 6.89x on Qwen3-8B, peaking at 8.77x; across temperatures it is 20-26% faster than Domino on Qwen3-4B and 27-36% on Qwen3-8B, and 11-20% faster than the stronger of DDTree and its cost-aware variant CaDDTree. A controlled decomposition attributes +10.1% (Qwen3-4B) and +10.7% (Qwen3-8B) accepted length to the correction, and +4.7% and +4.4% to conditioning on the realized path. Served in SGLang on one RTX 5090, it reaches 4.11x and 4.83x AR at batch size 1, 1.17x and 1.09x the speed of Domino's chain, and up to 1.71x AR on 8K-token HELMET summarization, 14-21% above the chain. The lead holds at 2 concurrent requests but reverses from 8 onward, where the chain sustains more goodput despite DominoTree's 28% higher acceptance. DominoTree accepts more tokens than the chain in every serving setting. On the hybrid Gated-DeltaNet Qwen3.6-27B, correct output requires tree-aware recurrent verification; with it, DominoTree matches the chain at batch size 1 (4.58x versus 4.54x AR) and reaches up to 2.11x AR at long context, 15% above the chain.
comment: 31 pages. Submitted to IEEE Access. v4: adds Qwen3.6-27B results, single-GPU serving re-runs, fused tree-builder kernels and tuned budgets; code and data at https://github.com/slin-zhq/Domino-Tree

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DominoTree，一种无需训练的优先搜索树推测解码方法，通过结合路径依赖的因果校正与树状结构，在保持高接受率的同时显著加速了大型语言模型的推理。
AI.motivation: 现有的树状推测解码方法（如DDTree）在评分时忽略了分支历史词元，而条件化解码方法（如Domino）只能生成单一链。本文旨在解决这两种方法各自的局限性，结合两者的优势以提高推理速度和接受长度。
AI.method: DominoTree构建了一种无需训练的优先搜索树，采用Domino的路径依赖因果校正进行评分，并将候选限制在top-M范围内，从而结合了DDTree的树状结构优势和Domino的路径条件化解码能力。
AI.result: 在零温度研究环境中，DominoTree在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上分别实现了5.33倍和6.89倍的自回归解码加速（峰值8.77倍）。在跨温度环境下，速度显著优于Domino、DDTree及其变体。在实际部署中（SGLang, RTX 5090），在batch size为1时达到4.11倍至4.83倍加速，且在长上下文摘要任务上表现优异。尽管在高并发（8及以上）时链式解码吞吐量更高，但DominoTree在所有服务设置下的词元接受量均更高。
AI.conclusion: DominoTree成功融合了树状起草和路径依赖评分，在单请求延迟和接受长度上实现了显著提升。对于混合架构模型，需配合树感知循环验证。未来在实际应用中需权衡其高接受率与高并发下的吞吐量限制。

title: GRAFT: Adaptive DLM-Based Draft Tree Construction with Target-Distilled Edge Scoring
summary: Tree-based speculative decoding raises the mean accepted tokens of standard speculative decoding by verifying multiple draft paths, and existing tree builders typically construct these paths through parent-conditioned expansion, where each child token is generated conditioned on its parent path. This construction is incompatible with diffusion language model (DLM) drafters such as DFlash, which produces all future-position distributions in a single forward pass. DDTree bridges this gap by treating high-probability tokens from each future-position distribution as candidate nodes and selecting edges between consecutive positions under a fixed node budget. However, its edge selection relies on token probability alone without modeling parent--child compatibility, so target-compatible tokens can be attached to wrong parents; moreover, its fixed budget ignores that the throughput-optimal tree size varies with the decoding state. We propose GRAFT, a draft-tree construction framework for DLM-based speculative decoding. GRAFT introduces Target-Distilled Edge Scoring (TDES), which distills parent--child preferences from target-model traces to select target-compatible edges, and State-Aware Budget Allocation (SABA), which sets the per-round tree budget by balancing expected draft gain against verification cost. Across multiple models and tasks, GRAFT achieves $2.13\times$--$6.36\times$ end-to-end speedup over autoregressive decoding while adding less than $0.5$\,ms of overhead per round, approximately $1.4\%$ of the target-model verification latency.

AI.tldr: 提出GRAFT框架，通过目标蒸馏边缘评分和状态感知预算分配，优化扩散语言模型推测解码中的草稿树构建。
AI.motivation: 现有DDTree等树构建方法在处理扩散语言模型草稿器时，仅依赖token概率选择边缘导致父子节点不兼容，且固定预算无法适应解码状态变化以达到最优吞吐量。
AI.method: 引入目标蒸馏边缘评分（TDES），从目标模型轨迹中学习父子偏好以选择兼容边缘；并提出状态感知预算分配（SABA），通过平衡草稿增益与验证成本动态设定树预算。
AI.result: 在多模型和多任务中，GRAFT相比自回归解码实现了2.13至6.36倍的端到端加速，每轮额外开销低于0.5毫秒（仅约1.4%的验证延迟）。
AI.conclusion: GRAFT成功解决了DLM推测解码中树构建的父子兼容性和预算动态分配问题，在极低开销下显著提升了推理速度。

title: Cost-Aware Diffusion Draft Trees for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates inference by having a lightweight drafter propose tokens verified in parallel by the target language model. Block diffusion drafters such as DFlash generate an entire draft block in one pass, yielding per-position marginals; DDTree uses these to build a candidate tree that maximizes expected acceptance length under a fixed node budget. We observe, however, that acceptance length is non-decreasing in budget: it always favors larger trees regardless of verification cost, offering no principled basis for budget selection. We introduce \textbf{CaDDTree} (Cost-aware Diffusion Draft Tree), a method that directly optimizes token throughput (expected tokens generated per unit time) by jointly selecting the tree structure and node budget. We model draft and verification latencies explicitly, show that the throughput objective decomposes into a per-round one-dimensional search over the budget, and prove that under a convex verification cost the throughput function is \emph{unimodal}, enabling an efficient greedy stopping rule. CaDDTree requires no offline budget search, adapting the budget each round from the current per-position distributions and verification cost. Experiments on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B across eight benchmarks spanning reasoning, coding, and instruction-following tasks show that \caDDTree{} matches or surpasses DDTree with oracle budget selection on nearly all tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CaDDTree方法，通过显式建模草稿和验证延迟，联合优化树结构和节点预算，直接最大化令牌吞吐量，无需离线预算搜索。
AI.motivation: 现有DDTree方法在固定节点预算下最大化期望接受长度，但由于接受长度随预算单调递增，无法为预算选择提供原则性依据，且忽略了验证成本的影响。
AI.method: CaDDTree直接优化令牌吞吐量（每单位时间生成的期望令牌数），显式建模草稿和验证延迟，证明在凸验证成本下吞吐量函数是单峰的，从而实现高效的贪心停止规则，每轮根据当前位置分布和验证成本自适应调整预算。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上跨8个基准测试（涵盖推理、编码和指令遵循任务）的实验表明，CaDDTree在几乎所有任务上匹配或超越了具有oracle预算选择的DDTree。
AI.conclusion: CaDDTree通过将吞吐量优化分解为每轮一维预算搜索并利用单峰性实现高效贪心停止，为推测解码中的树结构和预算选择提供了原则性解决方案，无需离线调参即可实现自适应优化。

title: TAPS: Target-Aware Prefix Tree Selection for Diffusion-Drafted Speculative Decoding
summary: Using a diffusion model for parallel drafting is a promising approach for speculative decoding. By predicting tokens at multiple future positions in a single forward pass, diffusion drafters substantially reduce drafting latency. However, this shifts the bottleneck to verification: verifying a single sequence limits acceptance length, while verifying large draft trees incurs excessive target-model latency. We identify a key mismatch in existing draft-tree methods: existing diffusion-tree methods rank nodes by the marginal probability, ignoring that verification is prefix-conditioned. As a result, they may verify unreachable descendants of rejected prefixes, increasing latency with limited acceptance gains. To address this, we propose TAPS, a target-aware prefix selection method that turns diffusion marginals into path-conditioned acceptance estimates. TAPS then selects a compact prefix-closed subtree under a fixed verification budget, improving the acceptance-cost tradeoff rather than simply expanding the draft tree. Experiments across diverse datasets and model families demonstrate that TAPS achieves up to 7.9x lossless end-to-end speedup over vanilla autoregressive decoding, outperforming state-of-the-art DFlash and DDTree by 1.36x and 1.74x respectively. Our work is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TAPS-EMNLP2026-53DD

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TAPS，一种用于扩散模型投机解码的目标感知前缀选择方法，通过构建紧凑的前缀闭合子树来优化接受率与验证成本的权衡。
AI.motivation: 基于扩散模型的并行草稿生成方法虽然降低了草稿延迟，但将瓶颈转移到了验证阶段；现有的扩散树方法使用边际概率进行节点排序，忽略了验证过程的前缀条件性，导致会验证被拒绝前缀的不可达后代，增加了延迟但接受率提升有限。
AI.method: TAPS方法将扩散模型的边际概率转化为路径条件下的接受率估计，并在固定的验证预算下选择一个紧凑的前缀闭合子树，从而改善接受率与成本的权衡，而不是简单地扩展草稿树。
AI.result: 在多种数据集和模型族上的实验表明，TAPS相比原始自回归解码实现了高达7.9倍的无损端到端加速，且分别比当前最先进的DFlash和DDTree方法快1.36倍和1.74倍。
AI.conclusion: TAPS通过解决前缀条件验证的瓶颈，有效提升了基于扩散模型的投机解码的性能，实现了显著的无损加速效果。

title: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Block Diffusion Draft Trees
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive language models by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple future tokens, which the target model then verifies in parallel. DFlash shows that a block diffusion drafter can generate an entire draft block in a single forward pass and achieve state-of-the-art speculative decoding performance, outperforming strong autoregressive drafters such as EAGLE-3. Vanilla DFlash, however, still verifies only a single drafted trajectory per round, potentially limiting its acceptance length. We introduce DDTree (Diffusion Draft Tree), a method that constructs a draft tree directly from the per-position distributions of a block diffusion drafter. Under a fixed node budget, DDTree uses a simple best-first heap algorithm to select the continuations that are most likely to match the target model according to a surrogate defined by the draft model's output. The resulting tree is verified efficiently in a single target model forward pass using an ancestor-only attention mask. Because DDTree builds on DFlash, a leading draft model for speculative decoding, these gains place DDTree among the leading approaches to speculative decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DDTree方法，通过块扩散起草器的逐位置分布构建草稿树，在单次目标模型前向传播中高效验证，以提升推测解码性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的DFlash推测解码方法每轮仅验证单条起草轨迹，这限制了其潜在的接受长度和加速效果。
AI.method: DDTree利用块扩散起草器的逐位置分布构建草稿树，在固定节点预算下采用最佳优先堆算法选择最可能匹配目标模型的延续，并使用仅祖先注意力掩码在单次目标模型前向传播中完成高效验证。
AI.result: 在DFlash基础上，DDTree有效提升了推测解码的接受长度，成为该领域的领先方法之一。
AI.conclusion: DDTree成功结合了块扩散起草器与树状验证机制，显著提升了推测解码的效率和性能。

title: Aligning MLLMs with the Latent Structure of Human Cognition via Behavior-Derived Semantic Dimensions
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive performance across a wide range of reasoning tasks, yet it remains unclear whether their internal representations and decision criteria align with the latent structure of human cognition. In this work, we propose a novel framework to align MLLMs with the multidimensional mental representations underlying human similarity judgements. We build on a previously established behavior-derived semantic embedding space, in which objects are represented along 66 interpretable dimensions derived from 4.70 million human Odd-One-Out (O1O) judgements. For each triplet, we infer the most salient decision dimension and convert it into a dimension-grounded linguistic rationale. This enables MLLMs to learn both the final choice and a justification consistent with the inferred behavioral criterion. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach improves model consistency with human similarity judgements while retaining competitive performance on standard multimodal benchmarks. Furthermore, using searchlight Representational Similarity Analysis (RSA) on an independent fMRI Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD), we observe increased representational alignment between model and human. Ultimately, our findings point to a data-driven route for incorporating human cognitive structure into MLLMs alignment. The code is available \href{https://github.com/ening-open/cogalign}{here}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新颖的框架，通过将多模态大语言模型与人类相似性判断的多维心理表征相对齐，以提高模型与人类认知结构的一致性。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型的内部表示和决策标准与人类认知潜在结构的一致性尚不明确，本文旨在解决这一问题并将人类认知结构纳入模型对齐。
AI.method: 基于包含66个可解释维度的行为衍生语义嵌入空间，推断每个三元组最显著的决策维度并转换为基于维度的语言学理据，使模型学习最终选择及行为标准一致的解释。
AI.result: 该方法提高了模型与人类相似性判断的一致性，在标准多模态基准测试中保持竞争力，且通过fMRI数据集分析显示模型与人类间的表征对齐性增加。
AI.conclusion: 研究指明了一条将人类认知结构纳入多模态大语言模型对齐的数据驱动途径。

title: Open-Weight MLLMs Cannot Compare What They Cannot Name
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly capable of understanding images and performing complex visual reasoning, suggesting the possibility of using them to automate biological image analysis. This need is becoming increasingly urgent as advances in technology continue to generate ever larger and more diverse microscopy datasets, already exceeding the scale at which manual visual analysis is feasible. With the final aim to use MLLMs for visual comparison of complex phenotypes, we investigate a very simple baseline: comparison of the size of body parts in synthetic images of ants. We find that state-of-the-art open-weight MLLMs fail for some body parts, but not for others, even though the comparison itself is visually trivial for all of them. We evaluate different in-context learning strategies and analyze performance on the related object recognition task. Our results suggest a recognition-driven grounding failure: structures that the models cannot recognize are instead associated with a recognizable semantic concept, impairing the grounding and comparison of both. Further analysis of the vision encoder is consistent with the hypothesis that fine-grained visual structure may be less well preserved without semantic support. Together, our results reveal a surprising limitation of current MLLMs: semantic recognition can gate simple visual comparisons that do not intrinsically require semantic understanding. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/kreshuklab/Open-Weight-MLLMs-Cannot-Compare-What-They-Cannot-Name

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了多模态大语言模型在视觉比较任务中的局限性：模型无法比较其无法语义识别的视觉结构。
AI.motivation: 随着显微图像数据集规模超出人工分析极限，本文旨在探索利用多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）自动化生物图像分析和复杂表型视觉比较的可行性。
AI.method: 通过合成蚂蚁图像构建一个简单的基线任务（比较身体部位大小），评估了不同上下文学习策略，并分析了物体识别任务及视觉编码器的表现。
AI.result: 模型对部分身体部位的视觉比较失败。分析发现“识别驱动的定位失败”：模型无法识别的结构被错误关联至可识别的语义概念，且缺乏语义支持的细粒度视觉结构在视觉编码器中保存较差。
AI.conclusion: 当前MLLMs存在语义识别能力限制简单视觉比较任务的局限性。

title: Multimodal In-Context Learning with Explicit Rule Induction
summary: A central challenge in multimodal in-context learning (MICL) arises from tasks that are ill-defined without context and require uncovering the underlying rules from demonstrations. Existing methods predominantly treat MICL as direct input-output mapping, overlooking the importance of explicitly inducing and reasoning over such rules, limiting both performance and interpretability. We propose ERIM, Explicit Rule-Induction for Multimodal In-Context Learning, a unified framework that enhances MICL by explicitly inducing the latent rules governing demonstration samples. Leveraging the reasoning ability of multi-modal large language model (MLLM), ERIM constructs rule-centric MICL datasets, introduces explicit supervision for rule induction, and fine-tunes MLLM to perform explicit rule-induction via a two-stage training strategy that combines mixed cold-start supervised fine-tuning with reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments show consistent performance improvements across diverse MICL settings and demonstrate that correctly inducing underlying rules directly leads to stronger and more stable performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ERIM框架，通过显式归纳多模态上下文学习中的潜在规则来提升模型性能与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 多模态上下文学习（MICL）面临的核心挑战是：某些任务在没有上下文的情况下定义不明确，需要从演示样本中挖掘潜在规则。现有方法主要将MICL视为直接的输入-输出映射，忽视了显式归纳和推理这些规则的重要性，从而限制了性能和可解释性。
AI.method: ERIM利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的推理能力，构建以规则为中心的MICL数据集，引入规则归纳的显式监督，并通过混合冷启动监督微调与强化学习相结合的两阶段训练策略，微调MLLM以执行显式规则归纳。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，ERIM在多种MICL设置下均实现了持续的性能提升，并证明了正确归纳潜在规则能够直接带来更强且更稳定的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: 显式规则归纳是提升MICL性能和可解释性的有效途径，正确诱导底层规则与更强、更稳定的性能直接相关。

title: Attention Maps Know When to Think: Training-Free Difficulty-Aware Chain-of-Thought for Reasoning Segmentation
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has become a standard reasoning strategy in Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs), showing strong performance in complex vision-language tasks such as reasoning segmentation. However, our analysis reveals that indiscriminate CoT usage can lead to degraded performance by inducing unnecessary reasoning, a phenomenon we term overthinking. In reasoning segmentation, overthinking often leads to misalignment between the query's intent and visual grounding. To address this, we propose Difficulty-Aware Chain-of-Thought (DA-CoT), a training-free adaptive framework that selectively triggers CoT based on the input's intrinsic difficulty. We find that the entropy of the model's attention maps reliably reflects task difficulty: low entropy indicates confident, localized grounding, while high entropy suggests uncertainty and potential benefit from CoT. DA-CoT uses this entropy signal to determine whether to apply CoT prompting. Additionally, we introduce a Bidirectional Rethinking mechanism that enables the model to automatically flip its reasoning decision when the initial output fails, enhancing robustness by recovering from failures induced by overthinking and underthinking. DA-CoT demonstrates its effectiveness by achieving state-of-the-art performance on the Reasoning Segmentation benchmarks while significantly improving inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出DA-CoT框架，基于注意力图熵值自适应触发多模态大模型中的思维链，以解决过度思考导致的性能下降问题。
AI.motivation: 无差别地使用思维链(CoT)会导致多模态大语言模型在推理分割任务中出现“过度思考”现象，引发查询意图与视觉定位的错位，从而降低性能。
AI.method: 提出无需训练的难度感知思维链(DA-CoT)框架，利用注意力图的熵值判断任务难度并选择性触发CoT；同时引入双向重思机制，在初始输出失败时自动反转推理决策以增强鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在推理分割基准测试中达到最先进性能，并显著提升了推理效率。
AI.conclusion: DA-CoT有效缓解了过度思考与思考不足的问题，实现了性能与效率的双重提升，双向重思机制进一步增强了模型的鲁棒性。

title: ReVEAL: Eliciting Role-Aware Latent Visual Evidence from MLLMs for Reasoning Video Object Segmentation
summary: Reasoning video object segmentation (ReVOS) requires segmenting the target specified by an implicit query throughout a video. Existing MLLM-based methods typically require costly cross-model alignment, tying MLLM training to a downstream segmentation model. We present ReVEAL, a decoupled thinking-with-video framework for ReVOS that elicits role-aware latent visual evidence from MLLM reasoning to directly guide segmentation. ReVEAL introduces Visual Evidence Tokens (VETs) into video reasoning to associate necessary visual regions or entities with target, background, or distractor roles, while a Dynamic Attention Layer Router adaptively aggregates VET-to-video attention across layers into role-specific grounding evidence. We train the MLLM to perform VET-augmented reasoning on our constructed ReVEAL-47K dataset, with a Contrastive Attention Grounding Loss as auxiliary supervision to apply role-specific constraints to VET attention and optimize layer routing for reliable latent grounding. At inference, ReVEAL identifies the target through this thinking-with-video process and fuses the resulting role-specific evidence to guide a frozen SAM2 in predicting target masks. Experiments on five benchmarks show that ReVEAL outperforms alignment-free baselines and remains competitive with alignment-based methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ReVEAL框架，通过引入视觉证据令牌和动态注意力层路由器，利用MLLM的推理直接引导分割，实现了无需跨模型对齐的推理视频目标分割。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于MLLM的方法通常需要昂贵的跨模型对齐，将MLLM训练与下游分割模型绑定。本文旨在解决这一对齐成本问题，实现解耦的视频推理与分割。
AI.method: ReVEAL引入视觉证据令牌（VETs）将视觉区域与目标、背景或干扰物等角色关联，并通过动态注意力层路由器聚合VET到视频的注意力以生成角色特定的定位证据。模型在构建的ReVEAL-47K数据集上训练，使用对比注意力定位损失作为辅助监督，并在推理时融合角色特定证据以引导冻结的SAM2进行掩膜预测。
AI.result: 在五个基准测试上的实验表明，ReVEAL优于无对齐基线方法，并在性能上与基于对齐的方法保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: ReVEAL通过解耦MLLM推理与分割模型，有效避免了昂贵的跨模型对齐，同时利用角色感知的潜在视觉证据实现了具有竞争力的ReVOS性能。

title: WebOverlay: High-Throughput Vision-Only Distillation for Extreme Aspect-Ratio Web Overlay Detection
summary: Web overlays, such as cookie consent banners, newsletter prompts, and age gates, obstruct automated web crawlers and degrade downstream document representations. While proprietary multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can accurately identify overlays, their latency and inference cost preclude web-scale ingestion. Conversely, lightweight vision models struggle with full-page renderings characterized by extreme vertical aspect ratios, where standard isotropic resizing collapses critical text features and causes false positives. In this work, we present WebOverlay, a high-throughput vision-only detector trained via distillation from a frontier vision-language teacher. We establish a dynamic tiling strategy that partitions extreme aspect-ratio web renders into aspect-preserving patches with spatial overlap, coupled with an aspect-ratio-aware boundary adjudication mechanism to eliminate boundary artifacts. To eliminate cross-modal latency overheads, our student model relies purely on visual cues, bypassing DOM tree parsing. WebOverlay significantly outperforms DOM-based heuristics and achieves competitive precision and recall against heavy proprietary MLLM baselines while delivering multiple orders of magnitude higher throughput and substantially reduced deployment costs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WebOverlay，一种高吞吐量、纯视觉的网页覆盖层检测器，通过知识蒸馏和动态平铺策略，在保持高精度的同时大幅降低了成本和延迟。
AI.motivation: 网页覆盖层会阻碍自动化网络爬虫并降低文档表征质量。专有的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）延迟和推理成本过高，而轻量级视觉模型难以处理极端纵横比的全页渲染，导致误报。
AI.method: 通过前沿视觉语言教师模型进行知识蒸馏，训练出仅依赖视觉的WebOverlay检测器。采用动态平铺策略将极端纵横比网页分割为重叠的、保持纵横比的补丁，并结合边界裁决机制消除边界伪影，完全绕过DOM树解析。
AI.result: WebOverlay显著优于基于DOM的启发式方法，在精确率和召回率上与昂贵的专有MLLM基线相当，同时吞吐量提高了数个数量级，大幅降低了部署成本。
AI.conclusion: WebOverlay成功解决了网页覆盖层检测中的成本与性能权衡问题，提供了一种高效、低成本的纯视觉解决方案，适用于网络规模的网页内容摄取。

title: PhysCount: Do MLLMs Count Visual Appearances or Physical Entities?
summary: Images reveal appearances, but counting often asks about physical objects. A single entity may be visible directly, in several reflections, or through glass, so detecting every visible occurrence does not determine how many entities are present. Existing visual counting benchmarks rarely separate these two operations. We introduce PhysCount, a benchmark for evaluating whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can distinguish what appears in an image from what physically exists in the scene. PhysCount contains 546 real-world images and 4,595 human-written questions organized into 651 target-specific groups. For each group, annotators locate the relevant appearances, label how each is observed, and identify appearances of the same entity. Four complementary question families test the enumeration of appearances, the enumeration of physical entities, image-formation-specific counting, and appearance--entity correspondence. We measure both accuracy on each family and the proportion of groups answered entirely correctly. Across 40 MLLMs, counting visible appearances is substantially easier than recovering the identities that connect them. Even the strongest model answers every question correctly in only 13.36\% of groups. Performance declines when one entity produces many appearances or when its appearances cross observation modes. Higher image resolution improves access to visual evidence but brings limited gains in complete-group accuracy, whereas answering related questions jointly produces a marked improvement. These results expose a gap between recognizing what is visible and correctly recovering the physical entities behind those observations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PhysCount基准，旨在评估多模态大语言模型在计数任务中区分图像视觉外观与实际物理实体的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉计数基准通常未区分图像中的视觉外观与实际存在的物理实体（如反射、透射等），导致检测所有可见出现并不能准确确定实体的真实数量，且当前模型在此方面存在明显不足。
AI.method: 构建了PhysCount基准，包含546张真实图像及4,595个人工标注问题，划分为651个目标组。通过四类互补问题评估对外观计数、物理实体计数、图像形成特定计数及外观-实体对应关系的能力。
AI.result: 在40个MLLM上的测试显示，计算可见外观显著易于恢复物理实体身份；最强模型仅在13.36%的组中全部回答正确。提高图像分辨率对完全正确率提升有限，而联合回答相关问题则有显著改善。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果揭示了当前模型在识别可见外观与准确恢复其背后的物理实体之间存在明显差距，为未来物理场景理解研究指明了方向。

title: Benchmarking color judgment in multimodal LLMs with CIE-computable ground truth
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are now used as zero-shot judges of image quality, but their color judgments are rarely tested with colorimetric ground truth. We present a five-task benchmark based on the CIE colorimetric framework: AWB pair judgment, skin-tone bias direction, CCT estimation, CIE Delta E 2000 pair ordering, and color naming under changing illuminants. We test eight MLLM endpoints, including four Qwen3-VL variants, GLM-4.5V, GPT-5.4, Claude-Opus-4.7, and Gemini-3.1-Pro. The models often solve coarse binary AWB judgments, but they remain weak on numeric CCT estimation and on some fine color-difference judgments. On ColorChecker-24 stimuli, the three closed-weight frontier models reach CCT MAE of 715-1056 K, compared with 1358-2133 K for the five open-weight models. A non-ColorChecker control shows that this advantage is partly template-dependent. The results suggest that current MLLMs have useful color words and coarse visual priors, but their color judgments are not reliably calibrated to CIE-computable color differences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于CIE色度框架的五任务基准以评估多模态大语言模型的色彩判断能力，发现模型在粗粒度任务上表现尚可，但在精细数值估计和色差判断上缺乏可靠校准。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）常被用作图像质量的零样本评判器，但其色彩判断能力很少经过色度学真实值的检验。
AI.method: 构建了一个基于CIE色度框架的五任务基准（包含自动白平衡配对判断、肤色偏色方向、相关色温估计、CIE Delta E 2000配对排序及变色照明下的颜色命名），并测试了8个MLLM端点。
AI.result: 模型能较好完成粗略的二元自动白平衡判断，但在数值相关色温估计和部分精细色差判断上表现较弱。在ColorChecker-24刺激下，闭源与开源前沿模型的CCT平均绝对误差分别为715-1056 K和1358-2133 K，且该优势部分依赖于模板。
AI.conclusion: 当前的MLLM具备有用的色彩词汇和粗略的视觉先验，但其色彩判断并未可靠地校准至符合CIE计算标准的色差上。

title: VideoMemBench: How Well Do MLLMs Remember in Video Conversations?
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can now process hour-long videos, making extended multi-turn dialogue over a single video a natural mode of use. Sustaining such a dialogue requires more than answering each question in isolation: the model must retrieve and reuse information established earlier in the conversation, both what it has seen and what it has said, an ability we term in-context video memory. Existing video QA benchmarks leave this ability unmeasured: their questions are mutually independent, never reference one another, and each is answerable from the video alone, so nothing ever requires carrying information across turns. We introduce VideoMemBench, in which each sample pairs a single video with a long multi-turn dialogue, whose turns are connected by typed cross-turn dependencies: an Episodic Dependency refers back to a visual episode described in an earlier turn, probing memory of what the model has seen, while an Answer Dependency builds on the model's own earlier answer, probing memory of what the model has said. Every dependency is verified considering two properties: 1) necessity, meaning the question cannot be answered without its earlier turns, and 2) non-leakage, meaning the question does not restate the information from its earlier turns. To enforce these properties, we design a construction pipeline with three LLM roles: a planner, a generator, and a judger, with each dialogue reviewed by human experts. VideoMemBench comprises 326 videos with 2,476 turns, of which 1,387 depend on earlier turns, including multi-parent dependencies and long-range call-back. Among over 20 evaluated open- and closed-source MLLMs, Claude Opus 5 performs the best with an overall score of only 45.7\%, highlighting the challenge of in-context video memory. Our dataset and evaluation are released.

AI.tldr: 提出了VideoMemBench基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在长视频多轮对话中的上下文视频记忆能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频问答基准测试无法衡量模型在多轮对话中重用早期信息的能力（即上下文视频记忆），因为它们的问题相互独立，不涉及对先前对话内容的引用。
AI.method: 构建了VideoMemBench数据集，将视频与长多轮对话配对，并引入情景依赖（记忆所见）和答案依赖（记忆所说）两种跨轮依赖。数据通过包含规划者、生成者和评判者三个LLM角色的流水线生成，并经人工审核以确保必要性和非泄露性。
AI.result: 数据集包含326个视频和2,476个对话轮次，其中1,387个依赖于先前轮次。在评估的20多个开源和闭源模型中，表现最好的Claude Opus 5总体得分仅为45.7%。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果突显了当前多模态大模型在上下文视频记忆方面的挑战，该数据集和评估框架已公开发布，以促进该领域的未来研究。
